children: President Donald Trump once again insisted that the U.S. should have the lowest interest rates in the world — at 1% or less — because "we are the Best Credit in the World — BY FAR," he said in a social media post on Wednesday.
The commentary came after the Federal Reserve, headed by Kevin Warsh, whom he picked earlier in the year for the role, implemented its first interest rate hike in more than three years,
to 3.75%-4.00%. The increase is needed to restrict economic growth enough to push down inflation, Warsh explained at the press conference following the decision.

While Trump didn't name Warsh or criticize him personally in the post, he ended his missive, saying, "LOWER THE INTEREST RATES FOR THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, AND FAST! President DONALD J. TRUMP."
The president said the new investment coming into the U.S. also justified a rate cut.

"Our Country is BOOMING with new Investment! If we stopped Trading with every country that we have a Deficit with, which is most of them, we would make, at least, 1.5 Trillion Dollars a year," he wrote. "The word 'Deficit' is nothing more than a fancy word for LOSS. We are 'carrying' almost every country in the World, and that cannot go on any longer," he said.

title: Trump calls for interest rates of 1% or lower, after Fed hikes to 3.75%-4.00%
